notes.title: Language Update!
notes.content:
Hello fellow woodsers!

We are delighted to announce that we have released a major update that not only fixes a some (mostly minor) bugs, we've also included 15 new languages!

Play A Day in the Woods in English, Dutch, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian, Russian, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, German, French, Polish, Swedish and Italian.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list][*]Added localization support
[*]Fixed the long standing Reset Progress bug
[*]Updated engine version so Woods should be more performant
[*]Various minor bugs[/list]

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: 13 November Patch Notes
notes.content:
Thanks to feedback from players we were able to stomp some end game bugs!

[list]
[*]Fixed game outro hang and missing related achievement.
[*]Fixed incorrect awarding of Reigning Monarch achievement, this achievement will be revoked for everyone, but will be re-awarded when the game starts again if achieved legitimately.
[/list]

Thanks for the feedback!

PS. Some of you may have noticed that there were two updates, the first was the wrong version, the correct one should be up and available now.

notes.title: Good news A Day in the Woods founders!
notes.content:
If you bought A Day in the Woods for PC or Mac before the Steam release, we have some good news for you!

As promised you will be receiving a [b]FREE[/b] Steam key for A Day in the Woods as a sign of our appreciation for supporting us so many years ago!

If you already bought A Day in the Woods on Steam, first of all [b]thank you[/b], second of all, don't worry, you can gift the key we sent you to family or a friend. Or give it away to a trick-or-treater!

The keys will be arriving in your inbox ~5am Pacific Time. If you bought A Day in the Woods and haven't received a key by this weekend, please contact us and we'll make it right!

Thank you again, founders!

The RetroEpic Software Team

notes.title: A Day in the Woods Released!
notes.content:
It's official! A Day in the Woods has been officially released on Steam!

Thanks to everyone who helped us Greenlight Woods, thanks to everyone who played it on other platforms, and thank you for visiting our page!

We hope you all enjoy helping Red find her way home!
